purpose: The S installation ships the W search bundle byte-for-byte. This file is the pin: it names the exact bytes the package must contain, so a build either ships those bytes or fails.

materialize.command: python3 scripts/vendor_ssak_bundle.py --from <path to a W release dir (needs bin/ssak-mcp and release/ssak-search-manifest.json)>
materialize.why_not_committed: The bytes are a build artifact, not source. W's own manifest records artifact_tracked_in_git=false, so the pin lives in git and the bytes are materialized into package data at packaging time (and ignored by git here). Never substitute a different hash: 'arbitrary latest download' is exactly what this pin forbids.
